name: Two Reapers
source:
The story follows the friendship of a Blue Reaper and their ghostly housemate (MC) as they discuss life, relationships, and possibilities of a future together. But that future becomes endangered when a strange Red Reaper comes into town, threatening to tear them apart.

[From [url=https://goddess-of-gales.itch.io/two-reapers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕“苍蓝死神”与幽灵室友（主角）之间的友情展开，两人畅谈人生、感情，以及携手共度未来的种种可能。然而当一名来历诡异的“绯红死神”现身镇上、妄图将两人拆散时，那份未来顿时岌岌可危。

[摘自[url=https://goddess-of-gales.itch.io/two-reapers]itch.io[/url]]
